description: Agentic OS Lifecycle Hooks v11: SessionStart (command: auto-init + briefing via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) and PostToolUse (command: mechanical dirty-state tracker). The former prompt hooks (UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, SessionEnd) were removed in 4.21.0 — measured dead: SessionEnd hooks cannot invoke skills, PreCompact output is compacted away, a UserPromptSubmit prompt hook costs one model call per prompt and injects nothing on approve.
